WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
across_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_stats
),
filtered_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.per_day_price,
    ara.overall_avg,
    rs.per_day_price - ara.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM rating_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN across_rating_avg ara
  WHERE rs.per_day_price > ara.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_above_average,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_ratings
